verdicts.decision_note: First concrete verification: the client reviewed the submitted clips and explicitly confirmed that their font selection worked well.
The client changes the caption implementation standard to require the exact brand-guideline font rather than a guessed font; overwriting the same font_standard key leaves no obsolete attribute.
Concrete regression after prior approval: the client reports that the submitted clips used an incorrect guessed font instead of the specified brand font.
The client changes the caption lettering standard to require matching the supplied reference design and videos; the existing font_standard key is replaced without requiring a separate removal.
The source establishes a required lettering revision but does not report a concrete observed font mismatch independently of the accompanying requirement change.
